name: Essar Chester Half Marathon
course: Predominantly flat closed roads from city to Mollington, Lea by Backford and Saughall, returning to Town Hall and Cathedral finish.
transport: Chester station is about a 10-minute walk; racecourse parking is £5 and weather-dependent.
facilities: Bag drop, village toilets and five drink stations on course.
rules: Start and finish are separate; road closures make moving between viewing points difficult.
reason: A mostly flat city-and-countryside half with five drinks points. The separate finish and weather-dependent racecourse parking matter for supporters.

name: Newcastle Town Moor Running Festival March
place: Exhibition Park and Town Moor, Newcastle
course: Flat multi-lap park route on tarmac and compact gravel, with distance splits.
transport: No dedicated parking or vehicle access to village; Haymarket Metro is about a 10-minute walk.
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and event village; all runners collect packs on race day.
rules: 10K and half pack collection 08:00–09:00, 5K 08:30–09:30; follow split signs carefully.
reason: A city park race with several distances and good Metro access. Multi-lap navigation and compulsory on-day pack collection are the main practical details.
